name: Itsuki Kei
source:
Studying in the same grade as Tatsuhiko, a 4th year university student who is also a daughter in a shinto shrine.

While relationship with Misaki is normal, she is very unfriendly towards Tatsuhiko.

A cool looking beauty that emits a delicate and mysterious presence.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=420145]Getchu[/url]]
